title: Long-distance healing in Australia over the phone

tellings.quote: I've seen it too many times. I've seen it happen in Australia >> over the phone >> long distance.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he has had many UFO encounters, says he has seen people healed from far away, including someone in Australia, over the phone. He tells it as something he has witnessed himself, saying, "I've seen it too many times." If true, it would mean healing can work at a distance, with no one in the room.
